continuity.narrative_arc: The cowherds decide to leave after unexplained calamities; Upananda recommends Vrindavan; Nanda leads the wagon migration; the community settles; Krishna discovers the flowering forest, Yamuna and Govardhana; he later ranges among the boys and tends calves with Balarama.
continuity.krishna_identity: Use shared krishna-vrindavan-youth contract and its four identity refs: youthful face, deep matte indigo-blue skin, long dark curly hair, yellow dhoti, muted red-orange shawl, plain unmarked forehead, one simple low gold band and one upright peacock feather; ordinary two-arm/two-leg anatomy. Identity refs guide appearance only, never pose or setting.
continuity.balarama_identity: Use art/bible/characters/d072-balarama-vraja-youth/character.json for youthful elder-brother proportions, natural warm-brown skin, restrained blue garment and ordinary human anatomy. Do not use the shared toddler-stage Balarama contract.
continuity.supporting_cast: Use shared Nandagopan, gopas, gopikas and Yashoda contracts. Upananda uses the new D049 contract because no shared Upananda contract exists. People have clearly brown warm skin, distinct faces and ordinary connected anatomy.
continuity.palette_arc: Traditional matte South Indian temple mural: firm dark contour, broad opaque mineral fields, ochre, deep maroon, warm cream, muted olive, and deep indigo reserved for Krishna. Warm human skin stays clearly brown (red-minus-blue under about 120); Krishna's blue skin stays deep indigo (blue-minus-red at least 40). Full bleed, no outer border, no gloss, no metallic gold, no rays, beams or shafts.
continuity.review_status_note: Independent round-h and round-i review found S001 pass, S003 v013 needs-fix for a visible forehead fleck, and S009 v008 needs-fix for orange/copper foreground faces; S010 v018 has not yet received a verdict because the reviewer received v017 by mistake. A single fresh independent exact-checksum review of all ten selected versions is pending against this final plan. Every candidate remains unapproved; portraits remain paused.
